_comment: Build profiles for the ovl_0700 overlay target. The profile DEFINITIONS are inherited from the EXE manifest via profiles_from (same Psy-Q GCC 2.7.2 era, -G0: overlays use no $gp-relative access), so a compiler-era fix lands once. Only the ASSIGNMENTS are owned here and may name only C spans of configs/USA/overlays/ovl_0700.yaml.
